purpose: Track independent historical station observation options for validating the ERA5-Land regional baseline. Accessible source pages do not imply all 80 subregions have matched stations or downloadable 1991-2020 records.
rules: Station observations remain independent from ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis.
Match station ID and valid observation date; preserve local observation-day definition, QC flags, station relocation/history, elevation and distance.
Do not claim station validation until records are downloaded, paired and quality checked.
Record fees, licensing and access limits before acquisition.

sources.notes: Select nearby long-running stations and inspect element coverage, station history and observation-day definitions.

ASOS offers minute/hour/day/month/year data; records begin in 1904 for some station/element combinations; 105 listed stations; QC flags exist for selected elements; long spans may require file-set download.

CMA open data catalogue lists national ground basic observations and a 1991-2020 ground climate normal dataset; historical international exchange station data also listed. Need identify the correct access portal, station inventory, download terms and usable elements before matching.
Official response says stations are available, records generally begin 1977 onward, hourly or daily formats; access is fee-based and requires contacting the data center.

TMD states about 1,200 stations and 127 WMO-standard observing stations; historical climate statistics require paid service. Its data portal lists station metadata, daily/monthly rainfall statistics and observations. Need confirm downloadable historical station data, terms and record lengths.

Official MET Malaysia ArcGIS Stesen MET layer was queried and 80 location candidates were ranked across all 8 Malaysia golf subregions. Every subregion has at least one official station location within 75 km. Layer station types include AWS, AWS - VAISALA, CLIMATOLOGICAL and RAINFALL. The location layer does not establish historical element coverage or daily record availability; request station IDs, station history and 1991-2020 daily PRCP/TMAX/TMIN availability before approving.
Official portal provides daily station records; coverage and record duration vary by station. Some additional climate data requires paid extraction.
SACA&D daily station series partly free for non-commercial research; availability varies. BMKG Data Online has access limits for some data products; confirm terms before commercial use.

NOAA GHCN-Daily station and element-inventory metadata were downloaded and ranked for all 80 regional points. Initial output: 791 top-10 candidate rows; all 80 regions have at least one station with PRCP/TMAX/TMIN inventory overlap during 1991-2020; 76 regions have a complete-element candidate within 75 km. Four Malaysia regions had no suitable NOAA candidate within 75 km; all four now have closer official MET Malaysia station-location candidates. Inventory overlap is not proof of daily completeness; no station is approved and no observation records were downloaded.

nextActions: Verify daily record completeness, QC flags, station history, relocation, elevation and representativeness for the 76 NOAA candidate-ready regions.
Request MET Malaysia 1991-2020 daily PRCP, TMAX and TMIN availability and station history for the 8 regional candidate groups, prioritizing MY-SOUTH-01, MY-ISLAND-01, MY-EAST-01 and MY-HIGHLAND-01.
Use the official MET Malaysia station inventory to compare station type and location; do not treat station type as proof of climate-element availability.
Obtain official national station inventories and element availability for countries/regions where GHCN station history or climate representativeness is weak.
Download a multi-year independent station observation pilot only after explicit station approval; pair with ERA5-Land and calculate bias, MAE, wet-day hit/miss and seasonal performance by subregion.

discoverySummary.interpretation: NOAA GHCN-Daily candidates cover all 80 regions at inventory level for PRCP/TMAX/TMIN, with a complete-element candidate within 75 km for 76. The four remaining Malaysia regions are covered by official MET Malaysia station-location candidates within 75 km. No candidate is approved: daily completeness, station history, element availability, QC, observation-day convention and regional representativeness remain to be verified.
